title: Repair the Security Locks
briefing: Someone has been here before you. The mechanism was a valid Max Heap, but a few locks have been knocked out of place and the vault has sealed itself. Find every chamber that a lower chamber now beats and put the pair back the right way round. Fewer swaps means less alarm, so repair the damage rather than rebuilding the whole vault.
hints: Only a handful of rooms are wrong. The ! marks every parent one of its children beats.
Sift Down here pushes one value down until both children are smaller. Sift Up here pulls one value up while it beats its parent.
Heapify all repairs the whole vault at once, but it is charged for every swap it makes.
